title: SafeMERGE: Preserving Safety Alignment in Fine-Tuned Large Language Models via Selective Layer-Wise Model Merging
reasoning: The paper presents a technical framework (SafeMERGE) for preserving safety alignment in LLMs during fine-tuning. While it discusses 'unethical prompts' and 'human values' in a general safety context, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, specific moral reasoning frameworks, or ethical philosophies.
